# Results (generated by `python -m ldp.experiment`)

Sessions: S1, S2, S3, S4, S5. Variants per session: 20. Runs: 1200. All numbers come from the simulator with scripted users, a scripted executor, and timing guesses (see README, Limits). They test the *design*, not real people.

## Hypotheses (written before the run, in SESSIONS.md section 6)

**H1 held.** Interactive voice vs basic voice, ledger rules, all sessions. Difference = interactive minus basic.

| measure | mean difference [95% interval] | pairs | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| latest_intent | 0.79 [0.71, 0.87] | 100 | better |
| unwanted_w | -0.39 [-0.49, -0.29] | 100 | better |
| recovery_s | -32.19 [-39.36, -25.55] | 94 | better |
| talk_over_s | -1.85 [-2.19, -1.50] | 100 | better |

**H2 held.** Interactive voice vs text + interrupt, hands-on sessions (S1, S2, S5), ledger rules. `off_app_s` is partly set by the typing-switch assumption; read it with the sensitivity table below.

| measure | mean difference [95% interval] | pairs | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| recovery_s | -4.71 [-4.89, -4.53] | 60 | better |
| input_s | -11.87 [-13.09, -10.69] | 60 | better |
| off_app_s | -31.60 [-33.92, -29.28] | 60 | better |

**H3 held.** Text + interrupt vs interactive voice, free-hands sessions (S3, S4). Held means no difference can be shown. Difference = text+interrupt minus interactive.

| measure | mean difference [95% interval] | pairs | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| completion | 0.00 [0.00, 0.00] | 40 | identical |
| latest_intent | 0.00 [0.00, 0.00] | 40 | identical |
| unwanted_w | 0.00 [0.00, 0.00] | 40 | identical |

**H4 held.** Ledger rules vs always-stop on wasted work, and vs never-stop on unwanted actions (interactive voice arm). Difference = ledger rules minus the other policy.

| measure | mean difference [95% interval] | pairs | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| wasted_s vs always_stop | -18.66 [-22.86, -14.51] | 100 | better |
| unwanted_w vs never_stop | -0.82 [-1.02, -0.63] | 100 | better |
